title: fix(mcp): align durable attempt freshness and continuation with live CLI HEAD reading
body:
Parent #3091 cross-surface conformance; #3090 durable MCP projection. Steven requested this dedicated consistency lane.

## Reconciled ownership

#5234 is merged CLI exact-attempt reading. #5199 / PR #5419 owns completeness/open-gap mapper semantics and is landed as645085567b84daa1db3741d88d2a22af0e2d5667. Its accepted f1 repair.rs blob3ddd3ce15027aefccf7b11738addcd80bb262302 is preserved; this lane does not duplicate that fix. #5366 owns the VS Code DTO consumer and changes no LSP/MCP protocol. Residual current terminal/failed next-action disagreement is separately tracked in #5413.

## Bounded complementary claim

At original source434d7243, CLI app/agent_status used live HEAD with after-phase lineage for awaiting attempts and exact after evidence for terminal attempts. MCP durable reads replayed stored continuation/recorded after.current; authentic bytes could survive a changed HEAD while MCP remained actionable. All four tool/resource reads share those document builders.

PR #5408 extracts the existing application HEAD reading for both interfaces, publishes current/historical/unknown facts, suppresses historical/unknown command/routes and weakens actionable receipt projection while preserving invalid/stale/limited producer refusals. Retained manifest/receipt bytes stay immutable. Ordinary awaiting descendants remain admitted. Durable Git/filesystem reads leave the async executor through an independent blocking worker; public stdio remains serial through matching reply flush.

LSP standard RepairCard remains an operational attempt projection and private compatibility receipt status uses a weaker gap-ledger identity. This issue does not claim full LSP receipt parity, concurrent public transport, cancellation of Git or dirty-byte currentness.

## Exact candidate and review

[PR #5408](https://github.com/EffortlessMetrics/ripr-swarm/pull/5408), same owner branch codex/cross-interface-receipt-continuation, published headcd757a638f4675b1473dbf1850a3efedce38581a, treeb1ae6a2169808cf2751d4c123c1ae5652a355283. Integration basis is actual landed64508556; parents are prior ade29c01 +64508556. The ordinary non-force merge resolved one docs/interop/mcp.md conflict by retaining both mapper and freshness documentation. No duplicate integration branch.

Owner Steven's dedicated cross-interface lane; isolated worktree <redacted-local-worktree-path> on verified native5700X DESKTOP-O7TJ92M. Own diff versus landedmain is11paths/734insertions/46deletions.

[Independent exact-combined review](https://github.com/EffortlessMetrics/ripr-swarm/pull/5408#pullrequestreview-5405406194) found no blocking source/oracle issue. Landed mapper/functions/eight genuine cases/two adapter selectors19rows remain unchanged. Own freshness/dispatcher/test blobs retain ade review. Direct installed rustfmt/diffcheck pass. Three prior review threads are resolved. GitHub now confirms this exact head mergeable; earlier ade DIRTY metadata is historical.

## Acceptance and proof boundaries

- Genuine old97d native CLI/MCP semantic RED with current/ordinary-descendant positives and historical/unknown negatives is recorded in the [native-before packet](https://github.com/EffortlessMetrics/ripr-swarm/pull/5408#issuecomment-5978001312). It is not candidate/combined GREEN.
- Seven combined subjects must pass: six actual prepare/finish/retention freshness fixtures plus delayed durable-reader dispatcher control.
- Six independent candidate-derived wrong implementations must each fail its specific semantic assertion with unchanged tests and successful setup, then restore exact source and GREEN: exact-before-only lineage, unconditional command, unconditional routes, unconditional actionable status, recorded-after-current receipt gate, synchronous dispatch.
- Preserve all8 authentic #5199 producer cases plus2 literal adapter selectors (8+11rows); literal compatibility rows cannot establish producer authenticity/stock observations.
- Run actual same-root retained attempt/receipt through CLI and four MCP stock tool/resource reads with current/descendant/historical/unknown/corrupt/cross-root controls and immutable bytes. Identify exact PR and actual combined source/image separately.
- Obtain current checkout/JUnit/run-context, required checks and earned REVIEW_READY before normal protected squash integration.

Current [PR-triggered Rust run37193430565](https://github.com/EffortlessMetrics/ripr-swarm/actions/runs/37193430565)/[GitHub Hosted worker111410278056](https://github.com/EffortlessMetrics/ripr-swarm/actions/runs/37193430565/job/111410278056) is active; CX alternatives skipped. Prior ade manual checks are historical. Current combined native GREEN/mutants/stdio remain NOT_ESTABLISHED; overall PR_IN_FLIGHT / REVIEW_INCOMPLETE.

## Resource closeout

Conditional native5700X heavy slot released again before start. No Cargo, native producer PID, cache copy, private target or lease exists.

D/E fixed local free245.32/226.64GiB fit capacity but are outside this executor's explicit writable roots (C task workspace and C Temp); TEMP/TMP are C. No D/E write probe, escalation or permission change attempted. This is the exact configured-write blocker, not an observed NTFS denial.

Latest read-only Win32 physicalfree and caller-available C both67,728,379,904bytes,991,096,832 below64GiBfloor. Further local growth stopped. Own lane100,201,277logicalbytes (95.56MiB), growth4,460,564bytes from prior95,740,713 inventory; no compiled target. Even all own logical bytes cannot recover the reserve. No archive scratch, purge/move, other-owner/shared-target mutation or user-data change. Retained proof/source preserved; no sufficient owned recovery here. Other-owner recovery needs that owner's custody/consumer reconciliation.

[Canonical checkpoint and preserved proof plan](https://github.com/EffortlessMetrics/ripr-swarm/pull/5408#issuecomment-5978179738) records source IDs, native-zero/slotrelease, fresh physicalcapacity, writable boundary and retained receipts. No package/release/deployment/credential/security changes.
